samples.analysis:
Google Chrome is open in Incognito mode, displaying a YOLOKFX webpage with the tab title beginning “How to Get Free SHEIN Product…”.

- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo and menu links: **HOME**, **FASHION**, **TRENDS**, and **CONTACT**, plus a search icon.
- The main page heading reads **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products”**, followed by text about the official SHEIN reviewer program and product-testing opportunities.
- A centered prompt says **“One last question and we will show you how!”** and asks how the user prefers to receive free items. It offers two green buttons: **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- Below is a large **SHEIN** logo with an **“OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM”** label and explanatory paragraphs noting that selection is **never guaranteed**.
- A section lower down is titled **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING”** and advises keeping a SHEIN profile complete and updated.
- Advertising is visible: a top banner saying **“Trusted by Top Companies”** with an **OPEN** button, and a right-side Capital One Shopping ad reading **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **Apply Codes** button.
